content:
julia: opened PR 518 to clarify structured-output patterns and add a tiny migration note for teams that relied on legacy parsing. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/518 :sparkles:
sam: Which pages are changing?
julia: /docs/guides/structured-output.md, /docs/reference/function-tool-calling.md, and snippets in /examples/structured. Also a new small section on streaming-safe parsing.
mina: Recommend default examples be lenient (allow unknown keys) and show how to opt into strict validation. many customers hit extra metadata fields from engine variants.
peter: Add short JS snippet for lenient AJV usage and a Python snippet using pydantic with extra = "allow". Keep examples tiny.
julia: Added a streaming tip: buffer until a full JSON envelope is received (look for first '{' and matching braces) and link to examples/stream-utils.js for a helper.
sam: Can we include a one-line SDK toggle so teams can flip legacy behavior while migrating? e.g., `client.options.legacyParsing = true` in JS and similar in others.
mina: I'll add a unit test that feeds example partial chunks to the parser to ensure it tolerates chunked streams.
ci-bot: docs-lint: broken link detected /docs/reference/function-tool-calling.md#old-anchor not found.
julia: Fixed anchor and pushed. updated PR description with manual QA checklist: run stream example, run SDK toggle, validate golden file.
sam: Small wording nit on the migration section but LGTM otherwise.
ci-bot: checks/ci passed  examples test-suite green.
julia: Merging after CI. Thanks all  should cut down on support tickets about malformed JSON and tool call parsing.
_meta: Single Slack thread document; messages in chronological order. Keep Slack-style brevity and participant prefixes.
